---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Rooster
title: '[Feature] '
labels: 'enhancement, needs-triage'
assignees: ''

---

**What problem would this solve?**
A clear and concise description of what you're trying to do. Ex. I always have to [...] when [...]

**What would you like to happen?**
A clear and concise description of what you want Rooster to do.

**Have you seen it elsewhere?**
If another app (Discord, Element, ...) does this well, tell us how it works there. Screenshots help.

**Alternatives you've considered**
Any workaround you use today, or other ways it could work.

**Additional context**
Which platform you use it on (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, browser), and anything else that helps.
